recommendation: Keep the audit as-is. If Public Health or FMG wants to revisit whether protocol intent belongs outside Immunization or whether ImmunizationEvaluation should return from the IG to core, handle that as a new proposal.
issue_request: FHIR-8406 asked to remove vaccination protocol details from Immunization and represent the evaluation/protocol information in a separate ImmunizationEvaluation resource; Jira is Published with a Persuasive with Modification resolution.
initial_application: The request was applied in December 2017 by f561c880f8 and 03306070c0, which added ImmunizationEvaluation and removed Immunization.vaccinationProtocol content from the Immunization source.
additional_context: FHIR-14536 and FHIR-16520 later approved adding Immunization.protocolApplied because FHIR-8406 removed needed dose-sequence/protocol context from Immunization. FHIR-18868 clarified protocolApplied is provider intent at administration time, not an independent evaluation. Current R6 history then removed ImmunizationEvaluation and ImmunizationRecommendation from active core source and points them to the Immunization Incubator IG.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit. Re-removing protocolApplied or re-adding ImmunizationEvaluation to core would reverse later final decisions and current build governance rather than complete FHIR-8406.
